# NSIS licence file

`COPYING` is copied unchanged from the NSIS source repository
(`https://github.com/kichik/nsis`, file `COPYING` on the default branch,
fetched 2026-11-26). It states the licences of NSIS: the zlib licence for
NSIS itself, the bzip2 licence for its bzip2 module and the Common Public
License, with a special exception, for its LZMA module.

No NSIS code is kept here. The Windows installer is made with NSIS and
contains its installer stub, so `cargo xtask notices` puts this file in
`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`.
